reply_text:
I replied to Marcus in a thread on his #north-random message.

- **Saved:** I added the corrected deadline to the workspace brain. The signed order form for Thornbury Cloth Co. is due 19 November. The note says it replaces the 21 December date he posted in #north-team this morning.
- **Not removed:** I tried to retire the old 21 December entry, but the brain said that entry couldn't be found. Both dates are still on file, though the new one clearly marks itself as the replacement.
- **Not touched:** I didn't post anything in #north-team, since he asked for no action. In my reply I suggested he post the fix there himself so Dana and Ilse see it.

The deadline is a signing date, not a money figure, so no approval was needed.
